#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

pass=0
fail=0

ok()   { echo "PASS: $1"; pass=$((pass + 1)); }
bad()  { echo "FAIL: $1"; fail=$((fail + 1)); }
expect_ok()   { [[ $? -eq 0 ]] && ok "$1" || bad "$1"; }
expect_fail() { [[ $? -ne 0 ]] && ok "$1" || bad "$1"; }

# --- capture + list -------------------------------------------------------
out1=$(./snapshot.sh capture "first snapshot")
[[ "$out1" == *"captured "* ]] && ok "capture prints confirmation" || bad "capture prints confirmation"

list=$(./snapshot.sh list)
[[ "$list" == *"first snapshot"* ]] && ok "list shows captured note" || bad "list shows captured note"

# --- as-of resolution -----------------------------------------------------
ts=$(echo "$out1" | grep -o '[0-9]\{8\}T[0-9]\{6\}Z')
# a date before any snapshot -> no match
./snapshot.sh as-of 19990101 >/dev/null 2>&1
expect_fail "as-of before all snapshots errors"

# same timestamp resolves to that snapshot
asof=$(./snapshot.sh as-of "$ts")
[[ "$asof" == *"$ts"* ]] && ok "as-of exact timestamp resolves" || bad "as-of exact timestamp resolves"

# --- verify: clean tree passes --------------------------------------------
./snapshot.sh verify >/dev/null
expect_ok "verify passes on unchanged tree"

# --- verify: modification detected -----------------------------------------
echo "# touched" >> src/compiler.py
./snapshot.sh verify >/dev/null 2>&1
expect_fail "verify detects modified file"

# restore the file and confirm verify is clean again
git checkout -- src/compiler.py 2>/dev/null || true
if grep -q '# touched' src/compiler.py; then
  bad "could not restore src/compiler.py"
else
  ok "restored src/compiler.py"
fi

# --- verify: untracked + new file detection ---------------------------------
./snapshot.sh verify >/dev/null 2>&1
expect_ok "verify clean after restore"

echo "new" > newfile.txt
./snapshot.sh verify >/dev/null 2>&1
expect_fail "verify detects untracked file"
rm newfile.txt

# --- as-of --verify reports drift against a changed tree --------------------
echo "# drift" >> examples/demo.calc
asof_v=$(./snapshot.sh as-of "$ts" --verify 2>&1 || true)
[[ "$asof_v" == *"HASH MISMATCH: examples/demo.calc"* ]] && ok "as-of --verify reports hash mismatch" || bad "as-of --verify reports hash mismatch"

sed -i '/# drift/d' examples/demo.calc
./snapshot.sh as-of "$ts" --verify | grep -q 'verify: OK'
expect_ok "as-of --verify clean after restoring content"

# --- second snapshot: as-of picks the right one ------------------------------
sleep 1
out2=$(./snapshot.sh capture "second snapshot")
ts2=$(echo "$out2" | grep -o '[0-9]\{8\}T[0-9]\{6\}Z')
[[ "$ts2" != "$ts" ]] && ok "distinct snapshot timestamps" || bad "distinct snapshot timestamps"

mid=$(date -u -d "$(echo "$ts" | sed 's/T/ /;s/Z//') + 1 second" +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)
resolved=$(./snapshot.sh as-of "$mid" | grep -o '[0-9]\{8\}T[0-9]\{6\}Z')
[[ "$resolved" == "$ts" ]] && ok "as-of between snaps picks earliest at-or-before" || bad "as-of between snaps picks earliest at-or-before"

resolved2=$(./snapshot.sh as-of 29991231 | grep -o '[0-9]\{8\}T[0-9]\{6\}Z')
[[ "$resolved2" == "$ts2" ]] && ok "as-of far future picks latest" || bad "as-of far future picks latest"

# --- tampering: manifest tree hash -------------------------------------------
python3 - "$ts" <<'EOF'
import json, sys
p = f".snapshots/{sys.argv[1]}.json"
m = json.load(open(p))
m["files"][0]["sha256"] = "0" * 64
json.dump(m, open(p, "w"))
EOF
./snapshot.sh as-of "$ts" --verify >/dev/null 2>&1
expect_fail "tampered manifest (tree hash) detected"
# remove the tampered manifest so later runs start clean
rm ".snapshots/$ts.json"

echo
echo "$pass passed, $fail failed"
[[ $fail -eq 0 ]]
